posts.zh:
dsh-daemon 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。将 DeepSeek Harness 的 web 服务（dsh web）注册为自启动、自愈的后台服务：LaunchAgent / systemd / cron 加 30 秒健康检查 watchdog，并提供 7 个 dsh_daemon_* 工具（安装/卸载/重装/状态/启动/停止/更新）。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-462da625ac6ab7f00ac5.html
posts.en:
dsh-daemon is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Registers the DeepSeek Harness web server (dsh web) as an auto-start, self-healing background service — LaunchAgent / systemd / cron plus a 30s health-check watchdog — with seven dsh_daemon_* tools (install/uninstall/reinstall/status/start/stop/update).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-462da625ac6ab7f00ac5.html
